decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting is close to the firm's specialist, standards-driven lighting knowledge base, so management is likely to keep learning from early sales and improve the line rather than withdraw it quickly.

A spring-balanced desk lamp fits the firm's ergonomic office-lighting competence, but it is less central to its broad application-solution strategy, so it carries a moderate risk of later pruning if demand is weak.
A general interior lighting luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core indoor-lighting capabilities and channels, making feedback easy to absorb and commercial improvements relatively low risk.

As a stated flagship product, this pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics is highly aligned with the firm's strategic move toward advanced, high-quality interior lighting and is therefore very unlikely to be dropped soon.

The marine HMI searchlight benefits from the firm's related marine and specialist-lighting know-how, but its technology is somewhat less aligned with the firm's LED- and sustainability-oriented direction, so review risk is higher.

A marine searchlight is well connected to the firm's existing expertise in robust specialist lighting, certified production and demanding transport applications, which supports keeping it on the market.
